pr.title: fix(cli): offer to close dated PRs
pr.body: Closes #126 - 🟣 ~~[feat(cli): add submit --rebuild-overview flag (#134)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/134)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[chore(cli): ignore independent trunk-siblings in stk commands (#133)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/133)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[chore(cli): add stack lock (#132)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/132)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(cli): offer to close dated PRs (#130)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/130)~~ (merged) 👈 - 🟣 ~~[feat(docs): add adopt/re-parenting guide (#129)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/129)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(providers): parse host better (#125)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/125)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(cli): correct headers passed to git apply (#124)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/124)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat/docs cleanup (#120)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/120)~~ (merged) - `main` --- Stack managed by [git-stk](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk)

expected.description: A single-branch submit closes the superseded review and clears the rename marker even though the ledger prune that removes stale rows only runs for a stack-wide submit, orphaning the old row in every other overview.
